# gyro_account_limits (Data Source)

Every limit of the account with its current usage (GET /cloud/account/limits). Account limits are raised with a support ticket (POST /api/v1/client/tickets or `gyro ticket create --department-id 3 ...`); plan limits also grow with a bigger plan or an add-on. Use it in a precondition to fail early, e.g. before creating more servers than new_account_servers allows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gyro_account_limits" "this" {}

locals {
  web_count = 3
}

# Fail at plan time instead of half-way through an apply when a new account would go over its limit.
# Account limits are raised with a support ticket: gyro ticket create --department-id 3 --subject "Limit increase: new_account.servers" --message "..."
resource "terraform_data" "limit_check" {
  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition = (!data.gyro_account_limits.this.new_account_applies ||
      data.gyro_account_limits.this.new_account_servers_used + local.web_count <= data.gyro_account_limits.this.new_account_servers)
      error_message = "Over the new-account server limit; open a support ticket to raise it (gyro ticket create --department-id 3 ...)."
    }
  }
}

output "limits" {
  value = { for l in data.gyro_account_limits.this.limits : l.key => "${coalesce(l.used, 0)} / ${l.limit == null ? "per plan" : l.limit}" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `limits` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `new_account_applies` (Boolean) True while the account is in its first days (prepaid cloud new-account limit applies).
- `new_account_container_environments` (Number) New-account limit: container environments.
- `new_account_ends_at` (String) When the new-account limit ends (Europe/Istanbul), empty when it does not apply.
- `new_account_servers` (Number) New-account limit: Gyro Cloud Istanbul servers.
- `new_account_servers_used` (Number) Gyro Cloud Istanbul servers that count toward the new-account limit.

<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Read-Only:

- `custom` (Boolean) Changed for this account.
- `description` (String)
- `group` (String)
- `how_to_increase` (String) open_support_ticket, upgrade_plan_or_open_support_ticket, upgrade_plan, wait or fixed.
- `increasable` (Boolean)
- `key` (String) Limit name, e.g. compute.max_vms, api.max_servers, s3.max_buckets.
- `limit` (Number) Effective limit (null: per service / per plan, or no limit).
- `scope` (String) account or service (then see services).
- `services` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits--services))
- `unit` (String)
- `used` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--limits--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits.services`

Read-Only:

- `limit` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `service_id` (Number)
- `used` (Number)
